Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 훈련 중 큰 부상을 당했다. 당분간 일정에 신경을 쓰자.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> was seriously injured during training. I decided to take extra care with the schedule for a while.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>がトレーニング中に大怪我をした。当分の間はスケジュールに気を配ろう。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在训练中受了重伤。暂时注意一下行程安排吧。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>在訓練中受了重傷。暫時注意一下行程安排吧。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a subi une grave blessure pendant l'entraînement. Faisons attention à son emploi du temps pour le moment.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat sich während des Trainings schwer verletzt. Wir sollten den Zeitplan für eine Weile im Auge behalten.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sufrió una grave lesión durante el entrenamiento. Decidí tener más cuidado con el horario por un tiempo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sofreu um grave ferimento durante o treinamento. Vamos ter mais cuidado com a agenda por um tempo.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้รับบาดเจ็บสาหัสระหว่างการฝึกซ้อม เราควรใส่ใจตารางเวลาเป็นพิเศษในช่วงนี้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengalami cedera serius saat latihan. Mari perhatikan jadwal untuk sementara waktu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã bị thương nặng trong quá trình huấn luyện. Hãy lưu tâm đến lịch trình trong một thời gian.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को प्रशिक्षण के दौरान गंभीर चोट लगी। कुछ समय के लिए कार्यक्रम का विशेष ध्यान रखना होगा।
